Thank you for reaching out! I can help your client understand German freelancer insurance requirements.

**Mandatory Requirements for German Freelancers:**

1. **Health Insurance (Krankenversicherung)** - MANDATORY
   - Must have either public (GKV) or private (PKV) health insurance
   - Minimum coverage: outpatient, inpatient, prescription drugs, mental health, maternity
   - Current plan (BerlinCare Basic) needs upgrading - missing mental health coverage and has limited specialist access

2. **Professional Liability Insurance (Berufshaftpflicht)** - MANDATORY for many freelancers
   - Required if client provides professional services/advice
   - Photography work especially needs this - covers equipment damage, client claims, copyright issues
   - Not currently included in their plan

3. **No statutory requirement for travel insurance** but highly recommended given their travel history (Nepal altitude sickness)

**Recommendations for upgrade:**
- Upgrade BerlinCare Basic to BerlinCare Pro (€235/month) - includes full mental health coverage, better specialist access, lower deductibles abroad
- Add Professional Liability add-on (€35/month) - covers photography work
- Keep Alternative Medicine (€45/month) - client uses this
- Keep Photography Equipment (€40/month) - essential for their work
- Add Adventure Sports Travel add-on (€25/month) - covers trekking, climbing, altitude-related issues

**Total proposed: €235 + €35 + €45 + €40 + €25 = €380/month**
**Current: €185/month**
**Increase: €195/month**

- BerlinCare Standard (€200/month) - basic mental health, moderate specialist access
- Professional Liability (€35/month)

- Basic Travel add-on (€15/month) - covers standard travel but NOT adventure sports
